#!/bin/bash
exec 2>/dev/null

for db in $(seq 0 15); do

    ot=$(/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db pttl "$k" | tr -d '\r')

  done < /tmp/old_keys_$db.txt
  # stream groups
  while IFS= read -r k; do
    [ -z "$k" ] && continue
    t=$(/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db type "$k" | tr -d '\r')
    [ "$t" != "stream" ] && continue
    og=$(/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db xinfo groups "$k" | tr -d '\r')
    ng=$(redis-cli -p 6380 -n $db xinfo groups "$k" | tr -d '\r')

    ol=$(/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db xlen "$k" | tr -d '\r')
    nl=$(redis-cli -p 6380 -n $db xlen "$k" | tr -d '\r')
    [ "$ol" != "$nl" ] && { echo "XLEN DIFF db$db [$k] $ol vs $nl"; bad=1; }
  done < /tmp/old_keys_$db.txt
done
echo "ttl+streams done, bad=$bad"
